finding: Refreshing a screen card recreated its receiver-stats callback. The viewer's watcher treated that as a new stream and reset the two-sample decoded-FPS window, even when the selected video track was unchanged.
change: The callback is now stable for each video track and changes when the track changes. This keeps decoded-FPS samples continuous across card metadata refreshes while still resetting after a track replacement.

limitation: Code and local tests improve measurement continuity but do not establish 60 FPS at a real viewer. QA-07 remains open until the POC-02 device and network matrix is measured.
